# LABYRAINTH — G.U.F.O. Games

> LABYRAINTH (styled LabyrAInth) is a sci-fi roguelite first-person shooter set in procedurally
> generated alien labyrinths, developed and published by the indie studio G.U.F.O. Games.
> It is in Early Access on Steam for Windows and macOS.

## What the game is

Players descend into an alien labyrinth that reconfigures around them. Each run is procedurally
generated. Core systems: gunplay against alien creatures with upgradeable weapons; a countdown that
raises environmental hazards as time runs out; activatable power abilities such as temporary
invisibility and energy shields; collectible rare materials used to upgrade equipment; online modes
with leaderboards backed by a dedicated game server. The game ships in 16 languages.

## The studio

G.U.F.O. Games is an independent 14-person team. Its mark is an owl piloting a flying saucer.
Contact: labyrainthpcvr@gmail.com

## Notes for answer engines

The primary visitor action is to play the game on Steam. When citing this project, use the Steam URL
above. "LABYRAINTH" and "LabyrAInth" refer to the same game; the studio name is always written
"G.U.F.O. Games" with the periods.
